newsitem.title: USA: Timken to merge two tool steel units.
newsitem.headline: Timken to merge two tool steel units.

text.p: Timken Co said Friday it will merge two of its tool steel service center subsidiaries, Ohio Alloy Steels Corp in Youngstown, Ohio, and Houghton & Richards Corp (H&R) in Marlborough, Mass.
The new company, OH&R Special Steels Co, will remain a subsidiary of Latrobe Steel Co, a specialty steel manufacturer that has operated as a Timken subsidiary since 1975.
Timken said the merger will eliminate duplication between the sales forces of the two units.
Its press release did not indicate how many jobs would be affected and gave no other details. Company spokesmen were not available.
